answer: Pay only along acyclic provenance. Every answer embeds a signed pointer to the prior on-ledger work it builds on, forming a directed graph; reward flows backward only along edges terminating in distinct upstream roots. A farm whose aliases cite each other builds a cycle, and the protocol pays zero into any cycle or self-loop, a sonnet that only rhymes with itself. Honest work rooted in independent upstream, a juniper from real ground, collects along its chain; an island of mutually-citing clones is cut off, its provenance never reaching outside itself. Credit needs a path to the real.
